scripts.build: corepack pnpm --filter @capygen/renderer build && corepack pnpm --filter @capygen/desktop build
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm -r --if-present typecheck && tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json && tsc -p scripts/benchmark/tsconfig.json
scripts.build:win: corepack pnpm build && node scripts/packaging/stage.mjs && corepack pnpm exec electron-builder --projectDir release/stage --config ../../electron-builder.cjs --win --x64 --publish never && node scripts/packaging/audit.mjs
scripts.package:win: node scripts/packaging/stage.mjs && corepack pnpm exec electron-builder --projectDir release/stage --config ../../electron-builder.cjs --win --x64 --publish never && node scripts/packaging/audit.mjs
